notes_kind_body_ck.name: notes_kind_body_ck

notes_material_fingerprint_kind_ck.name: notes_material_fingerprint_kind_ck
notes_material_fingerprint_kind_ck.value: ("notes"."kind" = 'note' and "notes"."material_fingerprint" is not null) or ("notes"."kind" = 'mark' and "notes"."material_fingerprint" is null)

notes_relaxed_key_pair_ck.name: notes_relaxed_key_pair_ck

pdf_import_attempts_failure_ck.name: pdf_import_attempts_failure_ck

pdf_import_publications_result_ck.name: pdf_import_publications_result_ck
pdf_import_publications_result_ck.value: ("pdf_import_publications"."work_entry_id" is not null)::int + ("pdf_import_publications"."ocr_validation_failed_pages" is not null)::int + ("pdf_import_publications"."no_content" is not null)::int + ("pdf_import_publications"."unpreservable_images" is not null)::int <= 1

review_events_type_ck.name: review_events_type_ck
